items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I can't remember what band I played with him with, but I remember playing with Charlie.

ctx.x: Yeah, I used to play with him, too.
I can't remember what band I played with him with, but I remember playing with Charlie.
What about Le Maire? You were telling me about helping Le Maire's band. I never did get that straight. It was in there.
